v.t: Alif, Lam, Ra. These are the Verses of the Book; a Quran that makes things clear
v.l: Alif-Lam-Ra Tilka 'Ayatu Al-Kitabi Wa Qur'anin Mubinin

v.t: Perhaps those who disbelieve would like to become Muslims
v.l: Rubama Yawaddu Al-Ladhina Kafaru Law Kanu Muslimina

v.t: Leave them to eat, and enjoy, and be lulled by hope. They will find out
v.l: Dharhum Ya'kulu Wa Yatamatta`u Wa Yulhihimu Al-'Amalu Fasawfa Ya`lamuna

v.t: We have never destroyed a town unless it had a set time
v.l: Wa Ma 'Ahlakna Min Qaryatin 'Illa Wa Laha Kitabun Ma`lumun

v.t: No nation can bring its time forward, nor can they delay it
v.l: Ma Tasbiqu Min 'Ummatin 'Ajalaha Wa Ma Yasta'khiruna

v.t: And they said, “O you who received the message, you are insane.”
v.l: Wa Qalu Ya 'Ayyuha Al-Ladhi Nuzzila `Alayhi Adh-Dhikru 'Innaka Lamajnunun

v.t: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you are truthful?”
v.l: Law Ma Ta'tina Bil-Mala'ikati 'In Kunta Mina As-Sadiqina

v.t: We do not send the angels down except with reason, and they will not be held back
v.l: Ma Nunazzilu Al-Mala'ikata 'Illa Bil-Haqqi Wa Ma Kanu 'Idhaan Munzarina

v.t: Surely We revealed the Message, and We will surely preserve it
v.l: Inna Nahnu Nazzalna Adh-Dhikra Wa 'Inna Lahu Lahafizuna

v.t: We sent others before you, to the former communities
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Min Qablika Fi Shiya`i Al-'Awwalina

v.t: But no messenger came to them, but they ridiculed him
v.l: Wa Ma Ya'tihim Min Rasulin 'Illa Kanu Bihi Yastahzi'una

v.t: Thus We slip it into the hearts of the guilty
v.l: Kadhalika Naslukuhu Fi Qulubi Al-Mujrimina

v.t: They do not believe in it, though the ways of the ancients have passed away
v.l: La Yu'uminuna Bihi Wa Qad Khalat Sunnatu Al-'Awwalina

v.t: Even if We opened for them a gateway into the sky, and they began to ascend through it
v.l: Wa Law Fatahna `Alayhim Babaan Mina As-Sama'i Fazallu Fihi Ya`rujuna

v.t: They would still say, “Our eyes are hallucinating; in fact, we are people bewitched.”
v.l: Laqalu 'Innama Sukkirat 'Absaruna Bal Nahnu Qawmun Mashuruna

v.t: We placed constellations in the sky, and made them beautiful to the beholders
v.l: Wa Laqad Ja`alna Fi As-Sama'i Burujaan Wa Zayyannaha Lilnnazirina

v.t: And We guarded them from every outcast devil
v.l: Wa Hafiznaha Min Kulli Shaytanin Rajimin

v.t: Except one who steals a hearing, and is followed by a visible projectile
v.l: Illa Mani Astaraqa As-Sam`a Fa'atba`ahu Shihabun Mubinun

v.t: We spread the earth, and placed stabilizers in it, and in it We grew all things in proper measure
v.l: Wa Al-'Arđa Madadnaha Wa 'Alqayna Fiha Rawasiya Wa 'Anbatna Fiha Min Kulli Shay'in Mawzunin

v.t: And in it We created livelihoods for you, and for those for whom you are not the providers
v.l: Wa Ja`alna Lakum Fiha Ma`ayisha Wa Man Lastum Lahu Biraziqina

v.t: There is not a thing but with Us are its stores, and We send it down only in precise measure
v.l: Wa 'In Min Shay'in 'Illa `Indana Khaza'inuhu Wa Ma Nunazziluhu 'Illa Biqadarin Ma`lumin

v.t: We send the fertilizing winds; and send down water from the sky, and give it to you to drink, and you are not the ones who store it
v.l: Wa 'Arsalna Ar-Riyaha Lawaqiha Fa'anzalna Mina As-Sama'i Ma'an Fa'asqaynakumuhu Wa Ma 'Antum Lahu Bikhazinina
w: and We gave it to you to drink

v.t: It is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritors
v.l: Wa 'Inna Lanahnu Nuhyi Wa Numitu Wa Nahnu Al-Warithuna

v.t: And We know those of you who go forward, and We know those who lag behind
v.l: Wa Laqad `Alimna Al-Mustaqdimina Minkum Wa Laqad `Alimna Al-Musta'khirina

v.t: It is your Lord who will gather them together. He is the Wise, the Knowing
v.l: Wa 'Inna Rabbaka Huwa Yahshuruhum 'Innahu Hakimun `Alimun

v.t: We created the human being from clay, from molded mud
v.l: Wa Laqad Khalaqna Al-'Insana Min Salsalin Min Hama'iin Masnunin

v.t: And the jinn We created before, from piercing fire
v.l: Wa Al-Janna Khalaqnahu Min Qablu Min Nari As-Samumi

v.t: Your Lord said to the angels, “I am creating a human being from clay, from molded mud.”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Qala Rabbuka Lilmala'ikati 'Inni Khaliqun Basharaan Min Salsalin Min Hama'iin Masnunin

v.t: “When I have formed him, and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down prostrating before him.”
v.l: Fa'idha Sawwaytuhu Wa Nafakhtu Fihi Min Ruhi Faqa`u Lahu Sajidina

v.t: So the angels prostrated themselves, all together
v.l: Fasajada Al-Mala'ikatu Kulluhum 'Ajma`una

v.t: Except for Satan. He refused to be among those who prostrated themselves
v.l: Illa 'Iblisa 'Aba 'An Yakuna Ma`a As-Sajidina

v.t: He said, “O Satan, what kept you from being among those who prostrated themselves?”
v.l: Qala Ya 'Iblisu Ma Laka 'Alla Takuna Ma`a As-Sajidina

v.t: He said, “I am not about to prostrate myself before a human being, whom You created from clay, from molded mud.”
v.l: Qala Lam 'Akun Li'sjuda Libasharin Khalaqtahu Min Salsalin Min Hama'iin Masnunin

v.t: He said, “Then get out of here, for you are an outcast”
v.l: Qala Fakhruj Minha Fa'innaka Rajimun

v.t: “And the curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”
v.l: Wa 'Inna `Alayka Al-La`nata 'Ila Yawmi Ad-Dini

v.t: He said, “My Lord, reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Fa'anzirni 'Ila Yawmi Yub`athuna

v.t: He said, “You are of those reprieved.”
v.l: Qala Fa'innaka Mina Al-Munzarina

v.t: “Until the Day of the time appointed.”
v.l: Ila Yawmi Al-Waqti Al-Ma`lumi

v.t: He said, “My Lord, since You have lured me away, I will glamorize for them on earth, and I will lure them all away.”
v.l: Qala Rabbi Bima 'Aghwaytani La'uzayyinanna Lahum Fi Al-'Arđi Wa La'ughwiyannahum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: “Except for Your sincere servants among them.”
v.l: Illa `Ibadaka Minhumu Al-Mukhlasina

v.t: He said, “This is a right way with Me.”
v.l: Qala Hadha Siratun `Alayya Mustaqimun

v.t: “Over My servants you have no authority, except for the sinners who follow you.”
v.l: Inna `Ibadi Laysa Laka `Alayhim Sultanun 'Illa Mani Attaba`aka Mina Al-Ghawina

v.t: And Hell is the meeting-place for them all
v.l: Wa 'Inna Jahannama Lamaw`iduhum 'Ajma`ina
w: (is) surely the promised place for them

v.t: “It has seven doors; for each door is an assigned class.”
v.l: Laha Sab`atu 'Abwabin Likulli Babin Minhum Juz'un Maqsumun

v.t: But the righteous will be in gardens with springs
v.l: Inna Al-Muttaqina Fi Jannatin Wa `Uyunin

v.t: “Enter it in peace and security.”
v.l: Adkhuluha Bisalamin 'Aminina

v.t: And We will remove all ill-feelings from their hearts—brothers and sisters, on couches facing one another
v.l: Wa Naza`na Ma Fi Sudurihim Min Ghillin 'Ikhwanaan `Ala Sururin Mutaqabilina

v.t: No fatigue will ever touch them therein, nor will they be asked to leave it
v.l: La Yamassuhum Fiha Nasabun Wa Ma Hum Minha Bimukhrajina

v.t: Inform My servants that I am the Forgiver, the Merciful
v.l: Nabbi' `Ibadi 'Anni 'Ana Al-Ghafuru Ar-Rahimu

v.t: And that My punishment is the painful punishment
v.l: Wa 'Anna `Adhabi Huwa Al-`Adhabu Al-'Alimu

v.t: And inform them of the guests of Abraham
v.l: Wa Nabbi'hum `An Đayfi 'Ibrahima

v.t: When they entered upon him, and said, “Peace.” He said, “We are wary of you.”
v.l: Idh Dakhalu `Alayhi Faqalu Salamaan Qala 'Inna Minkum Wajiluna

v.t: They said, “Do not fear; we bring you good news of a boy endowed with knowledge.”
v.l: Qalu La Tawjal 'Inna Nubashiruka Bighulamin `Alimin

v.t: He said, “Do you bring me good news, when old age has overtaken me? What good news do you bring?”
v.l: Qala 'Abashartumuni `Ala 'An Massaniya Al-Kibaru Fabima Tubashiruna
w: Do you give me glad tidings
Do you give me glad tidings

v.t: They said, “We bring you good news in truth, so do not despair.”
v.l: Qalu Basharnaka Bil-Haqqi Fala Takun Mina Al-Qanitina

v.t: He said, “And who despairs of his Lord’s mercy but the lost?”
v.l: Qala Wa Man Yaqnatu Min Rahmati Rabbihi 'Illa Ađ-Đalluna

v.t: He said, “So what is your business, O envoys?”
v.l: Qala Fama Khatbukum 'Ayyuha Al-Mursaluna

v.t: They said, “We were sent to a sinful people.”
v.l: Qalu 'Inna 'Ursilna 'Ila Qawmin Mujrimina

v.t: “Except for the family of Lot; we will save them all.”
v.l: Illa 'Ala Lutin 'Inna Lamunajjuhum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: “Except for his wife.” We have determined that she will be of those who lag behind
v.l: Illa Amra'atahu Qaddarna 'Innaha Lamina Al-Ghabirina

v.t: And when the envoys came to the family of Lot
v.l: FalammA JA'a 'A€la LA«A£in Al-MursalA«na

v.t: He said, “You are a people unknown to me.”
v.l: Qala 'Innakum Qawmun Munkaruna

v.t: They said, “We bring you what they have doubts about.”
v.l: Qalu Bal Ji'naka Bima Kanu Fihi Yamtaruna

v.t: “We bring you the truth, and we are truthful.”
v.l: Wa 'Ataynaka Bil-Haqqi Wa 'Inna Lasadiquna
w: And we have come to you

v.t: “Travel with your family at the dead of the night, and follow up behind them, and let none of you look back, and proceed as commanded.”
v.l: Fa'asri Bi'ahlika Biqit`in Mina Al-Layli Wa Attabi` 'Adbarahum Wa La Yaltafit Minkum 'Ahadun Wa Amđu Haythu Tu'umaruna

v.t: And We informed him of Our decree: the last remnant of these will be uprooted by early morning
v.l: Wa Qađayna 'Ilayhi Dhalika Al-'Amra 'Anna Dabira Ha'uula' Maqtu`un Musbihina

v.t: And the people of the town came joyfully
v.l: Wa Ja'a 'Ahlu Al-Madinati Yastabshiruna

v.t: He said, “These are my guests, so do not embarrass me.”
v.l: Qala 'Inna Ha'uula' Đayfi Fala Tafđahuni

v.t: “And fear God, and do not disgrace me.”
v.l: Wa Attaqu Allaha Wa La Tukhzuni

v.t: They said, “Did we not forbid you from strangers?”
v.l: Qalu 'Awalam Nanhaka `Ani Al-`Alamina

v.t: He said, “These are my daughters, if you must.”
v.l: Qala Ha'uula' Banati 'In Kuntum Fa`ilina

v.t: By your life, they were blundering in their drunkenness
v.l: La`amruka 'Innahum Lafi Sakratihim Ya`mahuna

v.t: So the Blast struck them at sunrise
v.l: Fa'akhadhat/humu As-Sayhatu Mushriqina

v.t: And We turned it upside down, and rained down upon them stones of baked clay
v.l: Faja`alna `Aliyaha Safilaha Wa 'Amtarna `Alayhim Hijaratan Min Sijjilin

v.t: Surely in that are lessons for those who read signs
v.l: Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatin Lilmutawassimina

v.t: And it is on an existing road
v.l: Wa 'Innaha Labisabilin Muqimin

v.t: Surely in that is a sign for the believers
v.l: Inna Fi Dhalika La'ayatan Lilmu'uminina

v.t: The people of the Woods were also wrongdoers
v.l: Wa 'In Kana 'Ashabu Al-'Aykati Lazalimina

v.t: So We took revenge upon them. Both are clearly documented
v.l: Fantaqamna Minhum Wa 'Innahuma Labi'imamin Mubinin

v.t: The people of the Rock also rejected the messengers
v.l: Wa Laqad Kadhaba 'Ashabu Al-Hijri Al-Mursalina

v.t: We gave them Our revelations, but they turned away from them
v.l: Wa 'Ataynahum 'Ayatina Fakanu `Anha Mu`riđina

v.t: They used to carve homes in the mountains, feeling secure
v.l: Wa Kanu Yanhituna Mina Al-Jibali Buyutaan 'Aminina

v.t: But the Blast struck them in the morning
v.l: Fa'akhadhat/humu As-Sayhatu Musbihina

v.t: All they had acquired was of no avail to them
v.l: Fama 'Aghna `Anhum Ma Kanu Yaksibuna

v.t: We did not create the heavens and the earth, and what lies between them, except with truth. The Hour is coming, so forgive with gracious forgiveness
v.l: Wa Ma Khalaqna As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđa Wa Ma Baynahuma 'Illa Bil-Haqqi Wa 'Inna As-Sa`ata La'atiyatun Fasfahi As-Safha Al-Jamila

v.t: Your Lord is the All-Knowing Creator
v.l: Inna Rabbaka Huwa Al-Khallaqu Al-`Alimu

v.t: We have given you seven of the pairs, and the Grand Quran
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Ataynaka Sab`aan Mina Al-Mathani Wa Al-Qur'ana Al-`Azima

v.t: Do not extend your eyes towards what We have bestowed on some couples of them to enjoy, and do not grieve over them, and lower your wing to the believers
v.l: La Tamuddanna `Aynayka 'Ila Ma Matta`na Bihi 'Azwajaan Minhum Wa La Tahzan `Alayhim Wa Akhfiđ Janahaka Lilmu'uminina

v.t: And say, “I am the clear warner.”
v.l: Wa Qul 'Inni 'Ana An-Nadhiru Al-Mubinu

v.t: Just as We sent down to the separatists
v.l: Kama 'Anzalna `Ala Al-Muqtasimina

v.t: Those who made the Quran obsolete
v.l: Al-Ladhina Ja`alu Al-Qur'ana `Iđina

v.t: By your Lord, we will question them all
v.l: Fawarabbika Lanas'alannahum 'Ajma`ina

v.t: About what they used to do
v.l: Amma Kanu Ya`maluna

v.t: So proclaim openly what you are commanded, and turn away from the polytheists
v.l: Fasda` Bima Tu'umaru Wa 'A`riđ `Ani Al-Mushrikina

v.t: We are enough for you against the mockers
v.l: Inna Kafaynaka Al-Mustahzi'ina

v.t: Those who set up another god with God. They will come to know
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yaj`aluna Ma`a Allahi 'Ilahaan 'Akhara Fasawfa Ya`lamuna

v.t: We are aware that your heart is strained by what they say
v.l: Wa Laqad Na`lamu 'Annaka Yađiqu Sadruka Bima Yaquluna

v.t: So glorify the praise of your Lord, and be among those who bow down
v.l: Fasabbih Bihamdi Rabbika Wa Kun Mina As-Sajidina

v.t: And worship your Lord in order to attain certainty
v.l: Wa A`bud Rabbaka Hatta Ya'tiyaka Al-Yaqinu
